_about: P0 Intake Brain (Stages 1-3): classify a NEW whole-circuit build request into a project_type + risk profile, score how much required info the prompt actually provided, and pick a 3-way decision BEFORE generating. Reuses sheet_planner.recommend_blocks (blocks), decide_render_mode._estimate_complexity (complexity/size) and pin_catalog.resolve_lib_ids_from_prompt (named parts) - this file adds ONLY the per-domain type/risk/required-fields layer. Adding a domain or a required field = one JSON edit, zero code.
_always_ask_assumptions_doc: Cursor-style 'ask before assuming' (2026-06-22, user: circuit design should INTERACT/ask the user, not silently assume). When true (default), the agent asks ONE round of 2-4 clickable chip-questions about the design choices it would otherwise ASSUME (supply voltage, package/footprint, indicator/connector, key values like frequency/current) BEFORE showing the build preview -- EVEN for simple/complete prompts that assess_request would PROCEED on (which is why the NE555 blinker silently 'Assumed 5V'). The model picks the questions that matter for THIS circuit (general, no hardcoded param list) and offers a 'use defaults' one-tap skip. Read by agent.py:_ask_assumptions_enabled, which appends ASK_ASSUMPTIONS_RULE to the build system prompt. Set false to restore the old behaviour (Low-complexity prompts build on one confirm with assumed defaults).

requirement_conformance._doc: Phase 3 drift/conformance check (validate._check_requirement_conformance). A part the USER explicitly named in the build prompt MUST appear in the generated circuit -- the architect must not silently DROP or SUBSTITUTE it. GENERAL: any part-number token, any domain, any prompt -- not BMS-specific. token_pattern finds part-number-shaped tokens (>=2 letters then >=2 digits, e.g. BQ76952/STM32G474/TJA1051/INA240/NE555); a token is SATISFIED if any component's lib_id OR value contains it (case-insensitive, so a package suffix like BQ7695201PFBR still matches BQ76952). token_exclude drops protocol/bus names that look like part numbers. Warning severity (the architect may have a valid reason to substitute -- surface it, don't hard-fail). No-op when the prompt is empty (e.g. the golden harness), so byte-stable there.

_decision_doc: Order: (1) SAFETY OVERRIDE - safety_critical OR risk_level in high_risk_levels never returns PROCEED; forced to ARCHITECTURE_FIRST (or ASK_QUESTIONS first if a field is missing) so a BMS / inverter / motor / charger is never silently generated even at a high score. (2) LOW-COMPLEXITY DIRECT GENERATE - a Low-complexity, low-risk request (complexity in direct_generate_complexity) goes straight to PROCEED regardless of score; honours the user rule 'IF Complexity = Low THEN Direct Generate' so a simple STM32-LED board is not needlessly questioned. (3) COMPLETENESS 3-WAY - everything else: score < ask_threshold_pct -> ASK_QUESTIONS; ask..arch_threshold_pct -> ARCHITECTURE_FIRST; > arch_threshold_pct -> PROCEED.
